active_product_bottleneck.observation: The >9.33 MB byte owner remains above the 1.25x Office create ceiling. Fully charged representative-staging v3 artifact 10797146802 falsified proof-derived logical identity: staging 168 occurrences -> 84 logical representatives saves 16.087 ms, but the required new all-occurrence inflate+CRC+SHA proof costs 29.032 ms, for -12.945 ms net and -25.429 ms margin versus the preregistered 12.484 ms create debt. Source review also sharpens the next boundary: current serial product staging already carries one cohort-wide validated_deflates cache keyed by exact compressed stream identity, so repeated exact Deflate streams are decoded once across winners; an all-occurrence native batch is therefore a mismatched control for the shipping serial path.
active_product_bottleneck.next_discriminator: Measure a native exact-stream-representative staging oracle that consumes the existing compressed identity boundary, validates/decodes each unique exact Deflate stream once, returns one logical object per unique exact stream plus deterministic occurrence mapping, and fully charges caller-visible bridge/assembly. No new logical proof pass. Compare against the actual serial cached Python staging semantics, not an all-occurrence native arm.

primary_question.hypothesis: The existing compressed-stream ownership fact can be reused across the implementation boundary: native staging of only unique exact streams may remove Python ZipFile/orchestration cost without paying a new logical-identity proof or returning duplicate logical buffers.
primary_question.kill: If a matched fully charged oracle against actual serial validated_deflates-cache semantics cannot recover >12.484 ms with credible residual margin, retire native exact-stream representative staging without product integration. A positive oracle permits exactly one bounded product attempt.

frontier_candidates.question: Can the already-known exact compressed identities drive one native validation/decode per unique stream and return only unique logical objects, beating the 12.484 ms create debt after bridge and assembly charges?
